info.name: List all backups for a cluster.

params.name: project_id
params.description: The ID of your project. You can get the project ID from the response of [List all accessible projects.](#tag/Project/operation/ListProjects).

params.name: cluster_id
params.description: The ID of your cluster. You can get the cluster ID from the response of [Get all clusters in a project](#tag/Cluster/operation/ListClustersOfProject).

items.docs: For TiDB Cloud Starter instances, you cannot manage backups via API. You can use [Dumpling](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidb/stable/dumpling-overview) to export your data as backups.

info.name: Create a backup for a cluster.

params.name: project_id
params.description: The ID of your project. You can get the project ID from the response of [List all accessible projects.](#tag/Project/operation/ListProjects).

params.name: cluster_id
params.description: The ID of your cluster that you want to take a manual backup. You can get the cluster ID from the response of [Get all clusters in a project](#tag/Cluster/operation/ListClustersOfProject).

items.docs:
- For TiDB Cloud Dedicated clusters, you can create as many manual backups as you need.
- For TiDB Cloud Starter instances, you cannot create backups via API. You can use [Dumpling](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidb/stable/dumpling-overview) to export your data as backups.
